_doc: Shared goose eyeball, used unchanged by every goose (PLAN F5/M9). Polar sphere around the look axis; theta = degrees from the look axis. Colours are sRGB, matched by eye to refs/characters-turnaround.png: black pupil, warm brown iris darkening to a limbal ring, thin cream rim, dark lid line. The sphere meets the head at embed_deg; the rest is buried. Eye bones for rigging pivot at the sphere centre.
